description: Interpreting a list of the shared literals as a propositional disjunction gives the same satisfaction relation as its finite set of members.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.list_clause.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (L : List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropLiteral α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.clauseFormula L) =
      true ↔
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat v L.toFinset
